verdict.rationale: Sierra's Agent SDK/Studio docs show agents can call customer APIs to execute actions (order changes, refunds implied by 'internal APIs' use), with guardrails, release governance, and human-in-the-loop approval, and a HN commenter confirms it wires directly into a customer's internal APIs. However there's no explicit documentation of per-action scoped auth/permissioning model for API calls. missing for 10: explicit scoped-auth/permission model per action, concrete refund/subscription action examples, independent confirmation of granular auth scoping.
